summary: Fake libcuda driver-API shim (libfakecuda.so) builds and answers cuInit/cuDeviceGetCount/cuDeviceGet/cuDeviceGetAttribute and 60+ other driver calls, but real NCCL cannot complete ncclCommInitRank through it: cudart's initOnceFunc calls cuGetExportTable with two fixed UUIDs and requires a real opaque export table. Static-cudart (pip wheel) and a from-source NCCL v2.32.3-1 built against DYNAMIC cudart (DT_NEEDED libcudart.so.13) both fail identically at that call. Acceptance #3 (no real driver loaded) was never relaxed; no partial PASS claimed.

nccl_build.result: build/lib/libnccl.so.2.32.3 with DT_NEEDED libcudart.so.13 (dynamic cudart); CPU-only build, no GPU time used
nccl_build.note: NCCL's src/Makefile defaults CUDARTLIB=cudart_static; CUDARTLIB=cudart is required for the dynamic path. libcudacxx headers were taken from the pip nvidia/cuda_cccl package via a cccl symlink in the sysroot.

acceptance.1_dlopen_real_nccl_single_rank_init: FAIL (see output.log probes A and B)
acceptance.3_no_real_driver_loaded: HOLDS; evidence: experiments/gpu-sim-m3d.5/proc_maps.log (libfakecuda.so mapped, no libcuda.so.1 mapping)
acceptance.4_negative_control_no_shim: PASS (output.log: without the shim and with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' the binary fails to init; with the real GPU visible it succeeds with 1 device)

cpu_runs.result: probe A FAIL, probe B FAIL, negative controls as expected

option_a_3alt.3-alt-iii: HOLDS: real handle opened with the real dlopen (dlvsym RTLD_NEXT); 'AUDIT real-driver-handle open=OK (via real dlopen, bypassing interception)'
option_a_3alt.3-alt-ii: HOLDS: GPUSIM_REAL_EXPORT_TABLE=0 (forwarding disabled) -> the export-table failure returns: 'cuGetExportTable -> 500 (NOT_FOUND, real driver disabled)', NCCL 'named symbol not found' AT the table
option_a_3alt.3-alt-i: FAILS. THE DISCRIMINATING FACT IS THE CHANGED FAILURE MODE, not a per-call attribution: with the real table served the handshake SUCCEEDS and cudart moves PAST it (the 'CUDA driver version is insufficient' error disappears), failing later with 'initialization error'; with forwarding disabled it fails AT the table with 'named symbol not found'. A zero counter in the 3-alt-i arm therefore does not by itself show which symbol served a call, and the earlier 'the export table carries the whole vtable / hands the entire device path to the real driver' mechanism claim is WITHDRAWN as not supported by this evidence (the shim demonstrably serves cuDeviceGetCount -> 1 and cuDeviceGet in that arm). What is established: serving the real table moves cudart past the handshake into code paths this seam does not control, so option (a) does not work.
option_a_3alt.counter_liveness_control: experiments/gpu-sim-m3d.5/attr_probe.log -- a direct shim call prints 'AUDIT cuDeviceGetAttribute served-by=SHIM attrib=16 value=80 count=1', so a zero elsewhere means 'not called', not 'counter broken'

dynamic_cudart_probe.detail: from-source NCCL v2.32.3-1 built with CUDARTLIB=cudart (DT_NEEDED libcudart.so.13, 0 libcudart_static symbols, 72 undefined cuda* symbols) still calls cuGetExportTable and fails identically.
